_comment: Competitor rates from Booking.com, SGD, LOWEST TOTAL PER ROOM CATEGORY INCLUSIVE OF ALL TAXES AND CHARGES (base + '+S$ X taxes and charges' line). Categories: Single/Studio/Loft/Suite; a category is omitted when that room type is absent or sold out. units_left_total sums remaining units across ALL room types (drives competitor occupancy). Kinn Habitat: by_category rates use PRIVATE rooms only (dorm capsule beds excluded), but units_left_total includes dorm capsule availability. NOTE: Hotel Clover The Arts, Hmlet Kada (Habyt Kada at Maxwell), Lyf Chinatown and Hmlet Chinatown have Booking.com property pages but return 'Not available on our site for your dates' on EVERY date scraped - they appear not to distribute via Booking.com rather than being genuinely full. They are stored as status 'sold_out' for schema compatibility, but treat them as NO DATA, not as sold-out inventory, when reading Chinatown/Quays occupancy.
